# Security And Diagnostics Requirements Checklist: macOS Passthrough Release Hardening

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for metadata-only evidence, diagnostics redaction, secrets boundaries, and no-egress guarantees.
**Created**: 2026-06-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [X] CHK001 Are forbidden evidence contents explicitly listed, including raw audio, transcript text, credentials, tokens, signed URLs, and meeting content? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Contract evidence]
- [X] CHK002 Are no-egress boundaries complete for recording, transcription, upload, MediaScribe, Langfuse, analytics, server upload, and storage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Constitutional Requirements]
- [X] CHK003 Are diagnostic and release-hardening evidence fields defined as metadata-only rather than meeting-content artifacts? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities, Contract evidence]
- [X] CHK004 Are deliberate policy or fixture strings that resemble forbidden fields accounted for separately from live secrets? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [X] CHK005 Is the distinction between short smoke evidence and future recording-assisted evidence explicit enough to prevent accidental recording-derived artifacts in this slice? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Contract deferred-recording]
- [X] CHK006 Are allowed evidence values such as device display names, route state, timing, CPU, process names, and pass/block reasons documented? [Clarity, Contract evidence]
- [X] CHK007 Are redaction expectations for credential-like paths or values specified with objective pass/fail language? [Clarity, Spec §SC-007, Contract evidence]
- [X] CHK008 Are external network egress exclusions stated as product requirements rather than implementation preferences? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Spec §Constitutional Requirements]

## Requirement Consistency

- [X] CHK009 Are evidence and diagnostics requirements consistent with the constitution's visible-control, data-boundary, secrets, and deletion-truth gates? [Consistency, Spec §Constitutional Requirements, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [X] CHK010 Are retention and deletion impacts consistently limited to local metadata evidence until a later recording slice defines content retention? [Consistency, Spec §Retention/Deletion Impact, Contract deferred-recording]
- [X] CHK011 Are MediaScribe and Langfuse boundaries consistently excluded from automatic startup, validation evidence, and future-gate placeholders? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-015]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [X] CHK012 Can diagnostics redaction success be objectively measured without inspecting raw meeting content? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [X] CHK013 Are result values for security-relevant evidence constrained enough to prevent skipped or unsupported targets from being silently accepted? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013, Contract evidence]
- [X] CHK014 Are local metadata screenshots or notes bounded so they do not introduce new uncontrolled deletion obligations? [Measurability, Spec §Retention/Deletion Impact]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [X] CHK015 Are secrets-like fixture strings addressed so scans can distinguish fixture policy text from live secrets without weakening the no-secret rule? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK016 Are diagnostics requirements broad enough to cover logs, screenshots, notes, evidence JSON, and QA artifacts? [Coverage, Spec §Key Entities, Spec §FR-012]
- [X] CHK017 Are future recording evidence privacy prerequisites defined before long-duration recording-assisted acceptance can become active? [Coverage, Contract deferred-recording]

## Notes

- Focus areas selected: metadata-only diagnostics, secrets redaction, no egress, and deferred recording evidence.
- Depth level: release-gate requirements review.
- Actor/timing: reviewer before `$speckit-tasks` and `$speckit-analyze`.
